execution_notes.status_mapping_rule: Smile Interview natively outputs semantic_alignment (MATCH / PARTIAL / MISSING) and deterministic gap_magnitude g. The 3-level report status maps deterministically as: Missing if semantic_alignment == MISSING; Meets Requirement if semantic_alignment == MATCH and g == 0; Partially Meets if semantic_alignment == PARTIAL or (semantic_alignment == MATCH and g > 0).

Full-Stack Engineer (Node.js / React)
Coral Booking
Ho Chi Minh City (onsite) | Full-time | 3–6 years experience
ABOUT THE ROLE
Coral Booking runs a travel-booking marketplace connecting independent hotels with travelers across Southeast Asia. We're a small, senior engineering team and need a Full-Stack Engineer who can move confidently between our Node.js backend and React frontend to ship features end to end.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
• Design and build features spanning our Node.js/NestJS backend and React/Next.js frontend.
• Model and evolve our PostgreSQL schema as booking and pricing logic grows more complex.
• Build and consume GraphQL APIs shared across web and internal admin tools.
• Own features from technical design through deployment and post-launch monitoring.
• Participate in architecture discussions as we scale beyond a monolith.
REQUIREMENTS
• 3+ years of professional experience with both Node.js (Express or NestJS) and React.
• Strong SQL skills and experience designing relational schemas (PostgreSQL preferred).
• Experience building or consuming GraphQL or REST APIs in production.
• Working knowledge of Docker and basic AWS services (EC2, S3, Lambda).
• Ability to work independently and communicate trade-offs clearly to a small team.
NICE TO HAVE
• Experience with payments or booking/inventory systems.
• MongoDB experience alongside relational databases.
• Startup experience owning a feature from 0 to 1.
BENEFITS
• Equity package
• 13th-month salary
• Annual team trip
